research_notes: Follow-up: identify hospitality, factory, childcare and call-centre employers and hours/breaks. Recover PwC partner appointment/cessation and campaign-leave records, resolve employment in 2021–2022, and date study. Locate original September 2019 appointment article or employer announcement.

Searches 2026-09-29: APH career, PwC employer-domain/appointment/end-date/full-time queries and NAFI records. Indexed 2009 employer submission adds contemporary corroboration. No full-time evidence found; similarly named musician, UK church staff and US professionals rejected.
Secondary summaries say PwC until election, but official APH gives 2019–2021. Do not extend to 2022 without stronger evidence. Secondary Conroy summaries also compress timing; retain APH 2009–2015.

Study and concurrent early jobs require overlap checks. Dates retained at year precision with null FTE; unknown employers are not assumed private from job title. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; initial record unresolved.

2026-10-02 follow-up: first speech adds Queanbeyan factory location and dishwashing duties, providing specific early-employer search leads. Checked APH, original11September2019 PwC appointment URL in both p526q6/p52qe6 variants (web open Internal Error), PwC domain,2019 transition reporting and early-job queries.18September2019 Australian indexed story forecasts departure next month; a forecast does not establish actual October start, so retain2019. No confirmed early employer identities/full-time terms or2021–22 work found. Next: Queanbeyan factory employment, hospitality/childcare/call-centre public CV; primary PwC partnership entry/cessation and campaign leave; historical ALP staffing records. Searches returned unrelated NZ call-centre professional, US musician and Harvard student; excluded. No chronology/hours or numerical totals invented.

2026-10-03 follow-up: a detailed Guardian account based on former colleagues observes factory work supporting Rae through university and identifies PwC work with James MacKenzie on non-government policy-oriented projects involving broad business and cost-of-capital understanding. It says Rae left PwC after Hawke preselection; preselection was reported on15June2021, but 'after' is not converted to an exact June endpoint. Separate contemporary reporting observed him as a partner on17April2021. These materially improve duty and transition evidence while preserving the official2019–2021 year range. Primary PwC appointment/cessation, full-time hours, leave and activity after departure remain unavailable. Early employer identities, multiple-factory question and study dates remain unresolved; no employment-year calculation.

2026-10-04 follow-up: the original 11 September 2019 PwC appointment story was located through an accessible Brisbane Times syndication and a 18 September report forecast that Rae would depart Victorian Labor the following month to take up the PwC partnership. Because the latter is prospective, it is not converted into an October employment start; the official 2019 year remains. Searches again found no exact actual commencement, 2021 cessation day, hours, leave, employer confirmation or post-PwC/pre-election paid role. Early hospitality/factory/childcare/call-centre employer identities also remain absent. Generic web search is exhausted for this pass; PwC personnel/partnership records and historical payroll/CV evidence are decisive. No substantive fact changed.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Official indexed parliamentary qualification list identifies a previously omitted Postgraduate Diploma in Management at Melbourne Business School and specifies ANU forestry science. Added undated study spell without inventing qualification years or part/full-time study load. Direct APH lang=en fetch reported restricted URL; usable official index evidence obtained separately without circumventing access controls. Education/first-job searches otherwise returned US cello, Boston engineering and UK charity namesakes; excluded. Primary early-employer identities, PwC partnership hours/leave and actual appointment boundaries remain unavailable.
